text: Asma has made all the __________ for the school play. They look cool!

explanation.A: صحيح! 'costumes' تعني أزياء المسرحية.

text: Don't forget your __________. It's going to rain later today.

explanation.A: صحيح! 'umbrella' تعني مظلة.

text: Dad bought my new __________ for the next school year.

explanation.A: صحيح! 'uniform' تعني الزي المدرسي الموحد.

text: How long have you had those __________, Grandma? They look old.

explanation.A: صحيح! 'earrings' تعني أقراط الأذن.

text: We gave our mom a beautiful silver __________.

explanation.A: صحيح! 'bracelet' تعني سوار.

text: My mom gave me a special comb made of __________.

explanation.A: صحيح! المشط يصنع من الخشب عادة.
explanation.B: Silk حرير، لا يصنع منه أمشاط.
explanation.D: Gold ذهب، ممكن لكن الخشب هو الأكثر شيوعاً.

text: Is your ring made of real __________?

explanation.A: صحيح! الخواتم غالباً ما تكون من الذهب.
explanation.B: Wood خشب، ممكن لكن نادر للخواتم الثمينة.
explanation.D: Plastic بلاستيك، ممكن لكن ليس 'real' ثميناً.

text: You can't use __________ to make a tie.

explanation.A: صحيح! المعدن لا يصلح لصنع ربطة عنق.

text: Have you seen Farah's new __________ purse?

explanation.A: صحيح! 'spotted' تعني منقط.

text: Ashraf made a __________ sweater for his grandad.

explanation.A: صحيح! 'wool' تعني صوف، المادة المناسبة للسترة.

text: Reorder: new / made / Rana / necklace / Has / a / ?
options: Has Rana made a new necklace?
Has made Rana a new necklace?
Rana has made a new necklace?
Has a new necklace Rana made?

explanation.A: صحيح! الترتيب الصحيح للسؤال في المضارع التام: Has + فاعل + تصريف ثالث + مفعول.
explanation.B: خطأ: الفعل المساعد والفعل غير منفصلين بالفاعل.

text: Reorder: had / long have / earrings / you / How / those / ?
options: How long have you had those earrings?
How long you have had those earrings?
How long have had you those earrings?
How long you had those earrings have?

explanation.A: صحيح! السؤال عن المدة: How long + have/has + فاعل + تصريف ثالث.
explanation.B: خطأ: الفاعل يجب أن يأتي بعد 'have' مباشرة.
explanation.C: خطأ: 'had' هو التصريف الثالث ويجب أن يبقى بعد الفاعل.

text: Reorder: plastic / Have / used / to make / costumes / you / ?
options: Have you used plastic to make costumes?
Have you plastic used to make costumes?
You have used plastic to make costumes?
Have used you plastic to make costumes?

explanation.A: صحيح! الترتيب الصحيح للسؤال: Have + فاعل + تصريف ثالث + مفعول + باقي الجملة.
explanation.B: خطأ: المفعول 'plastic' يجب أن يأتي بعد الفعل.

text: Reorder: has / silver / How long / bracelet / Lailah / that / worn / ?
options: How long has Lailah worn that silver bracelet?
How long Lailah has worn that silver bracelet?
How long has worn Lailah that silver bracelet?
How long has that silver bracelet Lailah worn?

explanation.A: صحيح! السؤال عن المدة مع فاعل مفرد: How long + has + فاعل + تصريف ثالث + مفعول.
explanation.B: خطأ: 'has' يجب أن تسبق الفاعل في السؤال.
explanation.C: خطأ: 'worn' يجب أن يبقى بعد الفاعل.

text: Reorder: hair / his / Has / brushed / new brush / Arshad / with the / ?
options: Has Arshad brushed his hair with the new brush?
Has Arshad his hair brushed with the new brush?
Has brushed Arshad his hair with the new brush?
Arshad has brushed his hair with the new brush?

explanation.A: صحيح! السؤال: Has + فاعل + تصريف ثالث + مفعول + باقي الجملة.
explanation.B: خطأ: 'brushed' يجب أن يأتي قبل المفعول 'his hair'.
explanation.C: خطأ: الفاعل يجب أن يأتي قبل الفعل الرئيسي.

text: Write the sentence: This / ring / gold
options: This ring is made of gold.
This ring is made from gold.
This ring is make of gold.

explanation.A: صحيح! استخدام 'be made of' للمادة الخام: is made of gold.
explanation.B: 'Made from' تستخدم عندما تتغير المادة كيميائياً.

text: Write the sentence: My / earrings / plastic
options: My earrings are made of plastic.
My earrings is made of plastic.
My earrings are make of plastic.

explanation.A: صحيح! الفاعل جمع 'earrings' يأخذ 'are'.

text: Write the sentence: The / costumes / not / silk
options: The costumes aren't made of silk.
The costumes isn't made of silk.
The costumes aren't make of silk.
The costumes not made of silk.

explanation.A: صحيح! نفي مع جمع: aren't made of.

text: Write the sentence: Badria's / umbrella / not / wool
options: Badria's umbrella isn't made of wool.
Badria's umbrella aren't made of wool.
Badria's umbrella not made of wool.
Badria's umbrella doesn't made of wool.

explanation.A: صحيح! فاعل مفرد 'umbrella' يأخذ 'isn't'.

text: Write the sentence: This / tie / wood
options: This tie is made of wood.
This tie is made from wood.
This tie are made of wood.

explanation.A: صحيح! استخدام 'is made of' مع المادة الخام.

text: Complete the text: Have you been to the new arts and crafts market downtown yet? Oh, you (1) __________? There are different designers who make (2) __________ things from many different (3) __________. One stall has combs and brushes made from wood. There are lots of jewelry (4) __________ too! I saw earrings (5) __________ silk and wool. One designer makes bracelets from (6) __________ plastic. '(7) __________ have you been a designer?' I asked her. I wanted to buy a (8) __________ belt. In the end, I didn't have enough money, but I will try to (9) __________ my own belt and ring. Have you ever tried to make your own (10) __________?
options: Part 5: made of / made from / made in / made by
Part 7: How long / When / How much / Why

explanation.A: الإجابات الصحيحة: 1. haven't, 2. beautiful, 3. materials, 4. accessories, 5. made of, 6. recycled, 7. How long, 8. striped, 9. make, 10. designs
